Map out a road trip for college tours
A commenter says Claude planned an east coast road trip for their son's college tours, including flight options, contacts, schedules, and classes to sit in on.
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter said they used Claude to map out an East Coast trip for their son's college tours. According to the comment, it returned flight options, contacts, schedules, and even classes to sit in on; the post does not describe any tools, prompt details, or where the person had to step in.
How it went
They said they were fully impressed with the result. No numbers, comparisons, or shortcomings were given in the thread.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Plan a [number]-day road trip for [name] to tour colleges in [region], starting from [home city]. The schools are [list of colleges]. For each stop, give me flight or driving options, admissions contact info, tour and info session times, and classes a visitor could sit in on for [intended major]. Finish with a day-by-day schedule in a table and a list of anything I still need to book or confirm.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1rg6az1/whats_the_most_surprising_use_case_youve_found
